fusions.name: Road-Worn Kick
fusions.desc: A kick from the running board that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Stamping Halt
fusions.desc: You brake hard and stamp down. It deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds, and you move 15% faster for the first 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shorter Every Mile
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
